metadata.question: Did San Jose have a higher average nitrogen dioxide concentration than Los Angeles from 2018 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Date: 2018-01-01 to 2019-12-31 - Location: Two cities - San Jose, CA and Los Angeles, CA - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' (mol/m²) 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality assurance band 'qa_value' to filter out low-quality pixels (qa_value >= 0.75 is typically good) - This is about actual NO2 concentration, not clouds, so we should mask poor quality data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid result: NO2 values typically range from 0 to ~0.0003 mol/m² - Compare San Jose mean vs Los Angeles mean - C1: If either city has no images - C2: If after masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: If mean is None, NaN, or outside reasonable range - A: If San Jose > Los Angeles - B: If San Jose <= Los Angeles ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for San Jose and Los Angeles const sanJose = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.8863, 37.3382]); const losAngeles = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2437, 34.0522]); // Create buffer regions (10km radius) const sanJoseRegion = sanJose.buffer(10000); const laRegion = losAngeles.buffer(10000); // 2. Date range const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2019-12-31'; // 3. Load Sentinel-5P NO2 collection const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); // Filter for each location const sanJoseCol = no2Collection.filterBounds(sanJoseRegion); const laCol = no2Collection.filterBounds(laRegion); // Check collection sizes const sjSize = sanJoseCol.size().getInfo(); const laSize = laCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`San Jose images: ${sjSize}`); console.log(`Los Angeles images: ${laSize}`); if (sjSize === 0 || laSize === 0) { console.log('No data available for one or both cities.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Apply quality masking and calculate mean function maskQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.5); return image.updateMask(mask); } const sanJoseColMasked = sanJoseCol.map(maskQuality); const laColMasked = laCol.map(maskQuality); // Create mean composites const sanJoseMean = sanJoseColMasked.mean(); const laMean = laColMasked.mean(); // 5. Calculate regional statistics const sjStats = sanJoseMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: sanJoseRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const laStats = laMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: laRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const sjMeanValue = sjStats['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const sjCount = sjStats['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; const laMeanValue = laStats['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const laCount = laStats['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; console.log(`San Jose: Mean NO2 = ${sjMeanValue}, Valid pixels = ${sjCount}`); console.log(`Los Angeles: Mean NO2 = ${laMeanValue}, Valid pixels = ${laCount}`); // 6. Validation and answer if (sjCount === 0 || laCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after quality masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (sjMeanValue === null || sjMeanValue === undefined || laMeanValue === null || laMeanValue === undefined || isNaN(sjMeanValue) || isNaN(laMeanValue)) { console.log('Calculation failed: Invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check reasonable range (0 to 0.001 mol/m²) if (sjMeanValue < 0 || sjMeanValue > 0.001 || laMeanValue < 0 || laMeanValue > 0.001) { console.log('Values outside expected range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (sjMeanValue > laMeanValue) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
